summary.text: Doug Wozniak is a Republican state representative from Michigan House of Representatives District 59 and the Republican candidate for Michigan State Senate District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and business owner, he is not seeking re-election to the House.

paragraphs.text: Doug Wozniak, listed by Ballotpedia as Douglas Wozniak, lives in Shelby Township, Michigan, and graduated from Harper Woods High School.
He earned a B.A. in mathematics from the University of Michigan and a J.D. from Michigan State University.
His career experience includes founding and owning the Law Offices of Douglas C. Wozniak and working as a realtor, broker, and life and health insurance agent.

In the House, Wozniak's 2025 and 2026 assignments are the Families, Children, and Seniors Committee, where he is majority vice chair, the Judiciary Committee and the House Regulatory Reform Committee.
